New Forensic Science Lab to Enhance Crime Investigation Speed

A new state-of-the-art forensic science laboratory has been established in Ayodhya, aiming to significantly accelerate crime investigation processes. The facility is expected to improve the accuracy of forensic results, with advanced technologies like LiDAR potentially aiding in quicker identification of perpetrators. This development is seen as a boost for law enforcement's capabilities in tackling crime.
